summary: Back off driver daemon timeouts while retaining fast refused-socket recovery and held-work lease bounds.

replay.detail: No claim admission, canonical ordering, checkpoint, retention or replay change. Existing mailbox fences and per-operation idempotency keys remain unchanged.

schema.detail: No schema, indexes, persisted retry state or migration.

rules.detail: No authority, lease duration or work eligibility predicate changes.

compatibility.detail: Driver timeout retries use independent per-operation exponential bases of 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 30 seconds with jitter and an actual 30-second cap. Refused or absent sockets retry within one second. Success resets growth; known held-work expiry bounds renewal waits, and only an authoritative work selection with no held claim clears that bound. Existing feed and delivery-specific schedules are preserved.

downtime.detail: No coordinated stop or store conversion. Behavior changes when the updated client or driver starts; deployment is outside this patch.

manual.detail: No manual configuration or production repair required.

recovery.detail: An unresponsive daemon receives fewer driver retries, while local completion work remains on its regular tick. Existing stable mailbox tokens, renewal keys, owned subscription cancellation and warning rate limits remain. A retry wait bound cannot guarantee renewal through an outage longer than the lease or bound the next request duration.
